name: Kashiwazaki (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Kashiwazaki city emblem in white: an outlined pentagonal device enclosing a triquetra of three loops.
history: Municipal flag of Kashiwazaki, a city in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 July 1950.

features.role: Kashiwazaki city emblem — an outlined pentagonal device enclosing a triquetra of three loops
